reviewNotes: Reviewed every exported key against all 20 cards in data/pages74.json, accepted vocabulary/furigana and context. Resolve duplicated/unconverted 平飼い and 放し飼い (including egg and chicken compounds) as ひらがい and はなしがい; 脂のり as あぶらのり and 強い as つよい. Correct split 銘柄鶏 めいがらにわとり to めいがらどり using the lesson vocabulary, 世界中 to せかいじゅう in worldwide context, and ケージ飼い to けーじがい per the poultry terminology reading source https://www.asahi-net.or.jp/~my9y-hris/tori/yogo/yogo/yogo-ka/yogo-ka.html . Check contextual topic は→わ, directional へ→え and object を→お; preserve lexical はなしがい, はなして, はごたえ, はばひろい, はんばい, はいごう and はくしょく. Preserve long vowels in けーじ and じゅーしー; convert ブランド to ぶらんど. Questions, explanations, reasoned answers, long definitions and complete descriptive clauses use Nova generation speed 1.0; standalone vocabulary, production labels and short paired descriptors/choice lists use 0.85. Display text and lookup keys preserved. No listening or audible pitch-accent verification performed.
